class.name: AbilitySystemComponent
class.brief_description: The central hub for the Gameplay Ability System on an actor.
class.description: The AbilitySystemComponent (ASC) manages abilities, attributes, and effects for a specific node (Character, Object). It acts as the interface for granting abilities, activating them, and processing gameplay effects. The ASC uses an O(1) inverted index map to quickly find abilities associated with specific GameplayTags.

method.name: grant_ability
method.description: Grants a new ability to this component. The ability is added to the valid candidates list for future activation.

method.name: try_activate_ability
method.description: Attempts to activate an ability by its matching tag name. Returns true if an ability was successfully found and activated.

members.member: The AttributeSet resource managing the stats for this owner.
